subject: Compliance packaging: evidence delivery windows & implementation concession
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearcure.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@clearcure.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on compliance bundle scope and credits

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — ClearCure's product and latency profile look promising. Before we proceed to procurement, finance has asked for a clearer breakdown of the compliance add-on options and how you typically handle implementation vs. recurring credits. Two specific asks: 

1) Evidence delivery windows — we need SOC2+HIPAA evidence for our internal audit. What is the usual SLA for delivering audit artifacts and can that be accelerated as a one-time deliverable?

2) KMS/HSM pricing — we see references to "seat" pricing and "throughput" models in the proposal. For our EU deployment (data residency required), we want to understand the tradeoffs (capex-like seat vs variable throughput bill). Is there a blended option you would recommend for a 3-region rollout?

Finally, finance would like to know what kinds of one-time implementation credits you can offer if we sign a 24-month committed plan (monthly committed tokens + 2 dedicated GPU pools).

Attached: brief RFI list from procurement (procurement@clearcure.com copied).

Best,
Marta
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearCure Health

From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearcure.com>, procurement@clearcure.com
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on compliance bundle scope and credits

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. I've sketched practical options below so finance and procurement can pick what maps best to your contract/ops preferences. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through.

Summary of options (high‑level):
- Evidence SLA: standard delivery = 30 days after request for packaged artifacts (SOC2 report, audit logs export, attestation). Expedited delivery (5 business days) available as a one‑time service with an implementation credit offset. Expedited requires dedicated engineering runbook and limited escalations.
- KMS/HSM pricing: three models we offer — Seat (annual per-HSM node/license), Throughput (usage-based monthly per-encrypted-op), and Blended (small annual seat + lower per-throughput rate). For multi-region EU rollout we usually recommend Blended: maintains a baseline capacity (failover + attestations) and keeps variable costs aligned to production volume.
- Credits: for a 24‑month commitment with 2 dedicated GPU pools we can offer a one‑time implementation credit equal to 40% of the first 3 months of recurring compliance addon fees (capped), or alternatively a 6-month discount applied to the recurring addon line to help front-load cost relief.

I attached a redlined SOW draft and a pricing worksheet with sample math for the blended option. Key open items for us to confirm to finalize numbers: residency region exact list (you mentioned EU — is that EU-only or EU+US?), expected audit log ingest (GB/day), and whether you require HSM attestation frequency beyond our standard annual.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Thurs 21 Jan 10:00am CET (I can convert to your timezone) to go through the worksheet and narrow to one option. If that works, I’ll have Ben (pricing) on the call and loop Laura for contract language.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf, pricing-worksheet.csv

From: procurement@clearcure.com
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearcure.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 02:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Questions on compliance bundle scope and credits

Olga — thanks for the options. Two clarifications from finance: 
1) The 40% implementation credit — is that applied as an invoice line item or as an offset to a future monthly invoice? We need it to reconcile in our procurement system as a "one-time professional services credit" (for capex vs opex rules).
2) For the blended KMS option, please confirm approximate per‑month cost range for our expected ingest (we estimate 120GB/day of audit logs initially).

Also, we've attached a short RFI spreadsheet with expected data ingest and region list. EU = EU-only for now.

procurement@clearcure.com
Attachment: RFI-Rates.xlsx

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: procurement@clearcure.com, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearcure.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 06:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on compliance bundle scope and credits

Hi procurement team — Ben here (pricing). Quick answers: 

1) Implementation credit mechanics: we can issue the credit as a one-time invoice credit memo that your finance team can apply against the first invoice after go-live (this satisfies capex tagging and is on the invoice as a "Professional services credit"). We can also split it (30/70) across onboarding and the subsequent monthly invoice if you prefer to smooth. Please tell us your preferred accounting treatment.

2) Blended KMS cost ballpark (EU-only, 120GB/day ingest):
- Seat component: €3,000/month (covers 2 HSM nodes + attestation support)
- Throughput component: €0.008 per audit-event-equivalent (approx for encrypted ops); estimated monthly throughput cost = €1,200–€1,800 based on your ingest estimates
- Total blended estimate: €4,200–€4,800/month. We can reduce seat to €2,000/month if you commit to a 24‑month seat contract (we amortize).

Action items for us to finalize numbers: your confirmed ingest profile (daily peaks), exact residency endpoints, and whether you want expedited evidence SLA.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference
Attachment: KMS-license-matrix.xlsx, SOC2-2026-summary.pdf

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearcure.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@clearcure.com, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on compliance bundle scope and credits

Thanks Ben — that helps. Procurement prefers the one-time invoice credit memo (applied to first invoice). A few follow-ups: 

- Can you confirm the exact cap on the 40% implementation credit (dollar cap) so legal can review?
- For the seat reduction to €2,000/month with a 24-mo commitment — are there early termination terms (we may start with a pilot and then expand)?
- We'd like the expedited evidence SLA (5 business days) for the initial SOC2 package as part of onboarding. Please confirm any additional fees and whether that could be covered by the implementation credit.

If you can send a short note on termination and the credit cap, we can aim to get legal sign-off next week.

Thanks,
Marta

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearcure.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@clearcure.com
Date: Mon, 24 Jan 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on compliance bundle scope and credits

Hi Marta — Laura from Legal. Short answers to the open legal points below so your counsel can reconcile: 

1) Credit cap: Implementation credit will be capped at the lesser of (a) 40% of the first three months of recurring compliance addon fees or (b) €60,000. We will insert the exact cap language into the SOW and the invoice credit memo.

2) Early termination on seat contract: For the reduced-seat rate tied to a 24‑month commitment we include a pro-rata repayment clause: if ClearCure terminates early (without our material breach), remaining credit balance becomes immediately due pro-rata (standard amortization over remaining months). We can add a 90-day cure period on material breaches.

3) Expedited evidence SLA: We will treat the first expedited evidence request as billable, and it can be paid for using the implementation credit up to the cap above. Any additional expedited requests will be billed at our published professional services hourly rate (per SOW).

I'll update the SOW to reflect these points and share a redline by EOD Tue. Once you confirm, procurement can issue PO terms and we can prepare the DocuSign package.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Contracts Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: updated-SOW-redline.pdf
